nodes.text: Synthetic State Q DOI Claims Bulletin Q-2026-07, effective 2026-04-01, changes the standard from a response within 10 business days to a documented claimant contact or contact attempt within 3 business days of notice, with the attempt timestamp retained.
The compliance mapping for Q-2026-07 requires claim workflow fields notice_received_at, claimant_contact_attempt_at, contact_outcome, and rule_id Q-2026-07.
Deployed Claims Workflow v1.4, released 2025-01-10, routes a new notice to a 10-business-day diary and has no claimant_contact_attempt_at field or 3-business-day branch.
Production manifest dated 2026-06-01 still deploys Claims Workflow v1.4 for State Q. No Q-2026-07 migration is listed.
Change ticket REG-441 is marked 'mapping review pending' and its impact note says the new 3-business-day contact requirement has not been added to the claim workflow.
Synthetic State R Market Conduct Update R-18, version 3 effective 2026-02-15, requires a documented coverage-test result before a claim denial and requires the result to identify each test and input.
The new rule maps to a structured denial_precheck object containing test_name, input_snapshot, result, and rule_id R-18-v3.

Production Denial Workflow v2.0, released 2025-11-01, permits an adjuster to deny from an adjuster note. The denial schema has no denial_precheck object and the pre-denial step is only a free-text confirmation.
State R production deployment on 2026-07-10 remains DW-2.0. The release inventory shows no migration, feature flag, or control test for R-18-v3.
A synthetic denial generated on 2026-07-12 contains only the free-text note 'coverage reviewed'; it does not contain the required test names, inputs, results, or R-18-v3 rule ID.
